88: @HandlerPriority(-1024) //-2^10; to ensure we've picked up @FieldDefault's changes (-2048) but @Value hasn't removed itself yet (-512), so that we can error on presence of it on the builder classes.
89: public class HandleSuperBuilder extends JavacAnnotationHandler<SuperBuilder> {
90: 	private static final String SELF_METHOD = "self";
91: 	private static final String FILL_VALUES_METHOD_NAME = "$fillValuesFrom";
92: 	private static final String STATIC_FILL_VALUES_METHOD_NAME = "$fillValuesFromInstanceIntoBuilder";
93: 	private static final String INSTANCE_VARIABLE_NAME = "instance";
94: 	private static final String BUILDER_VARIABLE_NAME = "b";
95: 	private final HandleBuilder builderHandler = new HandleBuilder();
96: 	
97: 	class SuperBuilderJob extends BuilderJob {
98: 		JavacNode builderAbstractType;
99: 		String builderAbstractClassName;
100: 		JavacNode builderImplType;
101: 		String builderImplClassName;
102: 		List<JCTypeParameter> builderTypeParams_;
103: 		
104: 		void init(AnnotationValues<SuperBuilder> annValues, SuperBuilder ann, JavacNode node) {
105: 			accessOuters = accessInners = AccessLevel.PUBLIC;
106: 			oldFluent = true;
107: 			oldChain = true;
108: 			
109: 			builderMethodName = ann.builderMethodName();
110: 			buildMethodName = ann.buildMethodName();
111: 			toBuilder = ann.toBuilder();
112: 			
113: 			if (builderMethodName == null) builderMethodName = "builder";
114: 			if (buildMethodName == null) buildMethodName = "build";
115: 			builderClassName = getBuilderClassNameTemplate(node, null);
116: 		}
117: 		
118: 		void setBuilderToImpl() {
119: 			builderType = builderImplType;
120: 			builderClassName = builderImplClassName;
121: 			builderTypeParams = typeParams;
122: 		}
123: 		
124: 		void setBuilderToAbstract() {
125: 			builderType = builderAbstractType;
126: 			builderClassName = builderAbstractClassName;
127: 			builderTypeParams = builderTypeParams_;
128: 		}
129: 	}
130: 	
131: 	@Override
132: 	public void handle(AnnotationValues<SuperBuilder> annotation, JCAnnotation ast, JavacNode annotationNode) {
133: 		handleExperimentalFlagUsage(annotationNode, ConfigurationKeys.SUPERBUILDER_FLAG_USAGE, "@SuperBuilder");
134: 		SuperBuilderJob job = new SuperBuilderJob();
135: 		job.sourceNode = annotationNode;
136: 		job.checkerFramework = getCheckerFrameworkVersion(annotationNode);
137: 		job.isStatic = true;
138: 		
139: 		SuperBuilder annInstance = annotation.getInstance();
140: 		
141: 		job.init(annotation, annInstance, annotationNode);
142: 		
143: 		boolean generateBuilderMethod;
144: 		if (job.builderMethodName.isEmpty()) {
145: 			generateBuilderMethod = false;
146: 		} else if (!checkName("builderMethodName", job.builderMethodName, annotationNode)) {
147: 			return;
148: 		} else {
149: 			generateBuilderMethod = true;
150: 		}
151: 		if (!checkName("buildMethodName", job.buildMethodName, annotationNode)) return;
152: 		
153: 		// Do not delete the SuperBuilder annotation here, we need it for @Jacksonized.
154: 		
155: 		JavacNode parent = annotationNode.up();
156: 		
157: 		job.builderFields = new ArrayList<BuilderFieldData>();
158: 		job.typeParams = List.nil();
159: 		List<JCExpression> buildMethodThrownExceptions = List.nil();
160: 		List<JCExpression> superclassTypeParams = List.nil();
161: 		boolean addCleaning = false;
162: 		
163: 		if (!isClass(parent)) {
164: 			annotationNode.addError("@SuperBuilder is only supported on classes.");
165: 			return;
166: 		}
167: 		if (!isStaticAllowed(parent)) {
168: 			annotationNode.addError("@SuperBuilder is not supported on non-static nested classes.");
169: 			return;
170: 		}
171: 		
172: 		job.parentType = parent;
173: 		JCClassDecl td = (JCClassDecl) parent.get();
174: 		
175: 		// Gather all fields of the class that should be set by the builder.
176: 		ArrayList<JavacNode> nonFinalNonDefaultedFields = null;
177: 		
178: 		boolean valuePresent = (hasAnnotation(lombok.Value.class, parent) || hasAnnotation("lombok.experimental.Value", parent));
179: 		for (JavacNode fieldNode : HandleConstructor.findAllFields(parent, true)) {
180: 			JCVariableDecl fd = (JCVariableDecl) fieldNode.get();
181: 			JavacNode isDefault = findAnnotation(Builder.Default.class, fieldNode, false);
182: 			boolean isFinal = (fd.mods.flags & Flags.FINAL) != 0 || (valuePresent && !hasAnnotation(NonFinal.class, fieldNode));
183: 			BuilderFieldData bfd = new BuilderFieldData();
184: 			bfd.rawName = fd.name;
185: 			bfd.name = removePrefixFromField(fieldNode);
186: 			bfd.builderFieldName = bfd.name;
187: 			bfd.annotations = findCopyableAnnotations(fieldNode);
188: 			bfd.type = fd.vartype;
189: 			bfd.singularData = getSingularData(fieldNode, annInstance.setterPrefix());
190: 			bfd.originalFieldNode = fieldNode;
191: 			
192: 			if (bfd.singularData != null && isDefault != null) {
193: 				isDefault.addError("@Builder.Default and @Singular cannot be mixed.");
194: 				findAnnotation(Builder.Default.class, fieldNode, true);
195: 				isDefault = null;
196: 			}
197: 			
198: 			if (fd.init == null && isDefault != null) {
199: 				isDefault.addWarning("@Builder.Default requires an initializing expression (' = something;').");
200: 				findAnnotation(Builder.Default.class, fieldNode, true);
201: 				isDefault = null;
202: 			}
203: 			
204: 			if (fd.init != null && isDefault == null) {
205: 				if (isFinal) continue;
206: 				if (nonFinalNonDefaultedFields == null) nonFinalNonDefaultedFields = new ArrayList<JavacNode>();
207: 				nonFinalNonDefaultedFields.add(fieldNode);
208: 			}
209: 			
210: 			if (isDefault != null) {
211: 				bfd.nameOfDefaultProvider = parent.toName(DEFAULT_PREFIX + bfd.name);
212: 				bfd.nameOfSetFlag = parent.toName(bfd.name + SET_PREFIX);
213: 				bfd.builderFieldName = parent.toName(bfd.name + VALUE_PREFIX);
214: 				JCMethodDecl md = HandleBuilder.generateDefaultProvider(bfd.nameOfDefaultProvider, fieldNode, td.typarams, job);
215: 				if (md != null) injectMethod(parent, md);
216: 			}
217: 			addObtainVia(bfd, fieldNode);
218: 			job.builderFields.add(bfd);
219: 		}
220: 		
221: 		job.typeParams = job.builderTypeParams = td.typarams;
222: 		job.builderClassName = job.replaceBuilderClassName(td.name);
223: 		if (!checkName("builderClassName", job.builderClassName, annotationNode)) return;
224: 		
225: 		// <C, B> are the generics for our builder.
226: 		String classGenericName = "C";
227: 		String builderGenericName = "B";
228: 		// We have to make sure that the generics' names do not collide with any generics on the annotated class,
229: 		// the classname itself, or any member type name of the annotated class.
230: 		// For instance, if there are generics <B, B2, C> on the annotated class, use "C2" and "B3" for our builder.
231: 		java.util.HashSet<String> usedNames = gatherUsedTypeNames(job.typeParams, td);
232: 		classGenericName = generateNonclashingNameFor(classGenericName, usedNames);
233: 		builderGenericName = generateNonclashingNameFor(builderGenericName, usedNames);
234: 		
235: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = annotationNode.getTreeMaker();
236: 		
237: 		{
238: 			JCExpression annotatedClass = namePlusTypeParamsToTypeReference(maker, parent, job.typeParams);
239: 			JCTypeParameter c = maker.TypeParameter(parent.toName(classGenericName), List.<JCExpression>of(annotatedClass));
240: 			ListBuffer<JCExpression> typeParamsForBuilder = getTypeParamExpressions(job.typeParams, maker, job.sourceNode);
241: 			typeParamsForBuilder.append(maker.Ident(parent.toName(classGenericName)));
242: 			typeParamsForBuilder.append(maker.Ident(parent.toName(builderGenericName)));
243: 			JCTypeApply typeApply = maker.TypeApply(namePlusTypeParamsToTypeReference(maker, parent, job.getBuilderClassName(), false, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil()), typeParamsForBuilder.toList());
244: 			JCTypeParameter d = maker.TypeParameter(parent.toName(builderGenericName), List.<JCExpression>of(typeApply));
245: 			if (job.typeParams == null || job.typeParams.isEmpty()) {
246: 				job.builderTypeParams_ = List.of(c, d);
247: 			} else {
248: 				job.builderTypeParams_ = job.typeParams.append(c).append(d);
249: 			}
250: 		}
251: 		
252: 		JCTree extendsClause = Javac.getExtendsClause(td);
253: 		JCExpression superclassBuilderClass = null;
254: 		if (extendsClause instanceof JCTypeApply) {
255: 			// Remember the type arguments, because we need them for the extends clause of our abstract builder class.
256: 			superclassTypeParams = ((JCTypeApply) extendsClause).getTypeArguments();
257: 			// A class name with a generics type, e.g., "Superclass<A>".
258: 			extendsClause = ((JCTypeApply) extendsClause).getType();
259: 		}
260: 		if (extendsClause instanceof JCFieldAccess) {
261: 			Name superclassName = ((JCFieldAccess) extendsClause).getIdentifier();
262: 			String builderClassNameTemplate = BuilderJob.getBuilderClassNameTemplate(annotationNode, null);
263: 			String superclassBuilderClassName = job.replaceBuilderClassName(superclassName.toString(), builderClassNameTemplate);
264: 			superclassBuilderClass = parent.getTreeMaker().Select(cloneType(maker, (JCFieldAccess) extendsClause, annotationNode), parent.toName(superclassBuilderClassName));
265: 		} else if (extendsClause != null) {
266: 			String builderClassNameTemplate = BuilderJob.getBuilderClassNameTemplate(annotationNode, null);
267: 			String superclassBuilderClassName = job.replaceBuilderClassName(extendsClause.toString(), builderClassNameTemplate);
268: 			superclassBuilderClass = chainDots(parent, extendsClause.toString(), superclassBuilderClassName);
269: 		}
270: 		
271: 		// Check validity of @ObtainVia fields, and add check if adding cleaning for @Singular is necessary.
272: 		for (BuilderFieldData bfd : job.builderFields) {
273: 			if (bfd.singularData != null && bfd.singularData.getSingularizer() != null) {
274: 				if (bfd.singularData.getSingularizer().requiresCleaning()) {
275: 					addCleaning = true;
276: 					break;
277: 				}
278: 			}
279: 			if (bfd.obtainVia != null) {
280: 				if (bfd.obtainVia.field().isEmpty() == bfd.obtainVia.method().isEmpty()) {
281: 					bfd.obtainViaNode.addError("The syntax is either @ObtainVia(field = \"fieldName\") or @ObtainVia(method = \"methodName\").");
282: 					return;
283: 				}
284: 				if (bfd.obtainVia.method().isEmpty() && bfd.obtainVia.isStatic()) {
285: 					bfd.obtainViaNode.addError("@ObtainVia(isStatic = true) is not valid unless 'method' has been set.");
286: 					return;
287: 				}
288: 			}
289: 		}
290: 		
291: 		job.builderAbstractClassName = job.builderClassName = job.replaceBuilderClassName(td.name);
292: 		job.builderImplClassName = job.builderAbstractClassName + "Impl";
293: 		
294: 		// Create the abstract builder class.
295: 		job.builderAbstractType = findInnerClass(parent, job.builderClassName);
296: 		if (job.builderAbstractType == null) {
297: 			job.builderAbstractType = generateBuilderAbstractClass(job, superclassBuilderClass, superclassTypeParams, classGenericName, builderGenericName);
298: 			recursiveSetGeneratedBy(job.builderAbstractType.get(), annotationNode);
299: 		} else {
300: 			JCClassDecl builderTypeDeclaration = (JCClassDecl) job.builderAbstractType.get();
301: 			if (!builderTypeDeclaration.getModifiers().getFlags().contains(Modifier.STATIC)
302: 				|| !builderTypeDeclaration.getModifiers().getFlags().contains(Modifier.ABSTRACT)) {
303: 				
304: 				annotationNode.addError("Existing Builder must be an abstract static inner class.");
305: 				return;
306: 			}
307: 			sanityCheckForMethodGeneratingAnnotationsOnBuilderClass(job.builderAbstractType, annotationNode);
308: 			// Generate errors for @Singular BFDs that have one already defined node.
309: 			for (BuilderFieldData bfd : job.builderFields) {
310: 				SingularData sd = bfd.singularData;
311: 				if (sd == null) continue;
312: 				JavacSingularizer singularizer = sd.getSingularizer();
313: 				if (singularizer == null) continue;
314: 				if (singularizer.checkForAlreadyExistingNodesAndGenerateError(job.builderAbstractType, sd)) {
315: 					bfd.singularData = null;
316: 				}
317: 			}
318: 		}
319: 		
320: 		// Generate the fields in the abstract builder class that hold the values for the instance.
321: 		job.setBuilderToAbstract();
322: 		generateBuilderFields(job.builderType, job.builderFields, annotationNode);
323: 		if (addCleaning) {
324: 			JCVariableDecl uncleanField = maker.VarDef(maker.Modifiers(Flags.PRIVATE), job.toName("$lombokUnclean"), maker.TypeIdent(CTC_BOOLEAN), null);
325: 			recursiveSetGeneratedBy(uncleanField, annotationNode);
326: 			injectFieldAndMarkGenerated(job.builderType, uncleanField);
327: 		}
328: 		
329: 		if (job.toBuilder) {
330: 			// Generate $fillValuesFrom() method in the abstract builder.
331: 			JCMethodDecl fvm = generateFillValuesMethod(job, superclassBuilderClass != null, builderGenericName, classGenericName);
332: 			recursiveSetGeneratedBy(fvm, annotationNode);
333: 			injectMethod(job.builderType, fvm);
334: 			// Generate $fillValuesFromInstanceIntoBuilder() method in the builder implementation class.
335: 			JCMethodDecl sfvm = generateStaticFillValuesMethod(job, annInstance.setterPrefix());
336: 			recursiveSetGeneratedBy(sfvm, annotationNode);
337: 			injectMethod(job.builderType, sfvm);
338: 		}
339: 		
340: 		// Create the setter methods in the abstract builder.
341: 		for (BuilderFieldData bfd : job.builderFields) {
342: 			generateSetterMethodsForBuilder(job, bfd, builderGenericName, annInstance.setterPrefix());
343: 		}
344: 		
345: 		// Generate abstract self() and build() methods in the abstract builder.
346: 		JCMethodDecl asm = generateAbstractSelfMethod(job, superclassBuilderClass != null, builderGenericName);
347: 		recursiveSetGeneratedBy(asm, annotationNode);
348: 		injectMethod(job.builderType, asm);
349: 		JCMethodDecl abm = generateAbstractBuildMethod(job, superclassBuilderClass != null, classGenericName);
350: 		recursiveSetGeneratedBy(abm, annotationNode);
351: 		injectMethod(job.builderType, abm);
352: 		
353: 		// Create the toString() method for the abstract builder.
354: 		java.util.List<Included<JavacNode, ToString.Include>> fieldNodes = new ArrayList<Included<JavacNode, ToString.Include>>();
355: 		for (BuilderFieldData bfd : job.builderFields) {
356: 			for (JavacNode f : bfd.createdFields) {
357: 				fieldNodes.add(new Included<JavacNode, ToString.Include>(f, null, true, false));
358: 			}
359: 		}
360: 		
361: 		// Let toString() call super.toString() if there is a superclass, so that it also shows fields from the superclass' builder.
362: 		JCMethodDecl toStringMethod = HandleToString.createToString(job.builderType, fieldNodes, true, superclassBuilderClass != null, FieldAccess.ALWAYS_FIELD, annotationNode);
363: 		if (toStringMethod != null) injectMethod(job.builderType, toStringMethod);
364: 		
365: 		// If clean methods are requested, add them now.
366: 		if (addCleaning) {
367: 			JCMethodDecl md = generateCleanMethod(job.builderFields, job.builderType, annotationNode);
368: 			recursiveSetGeneratedBy(md, annotationNode);
369: 			injectMethod(job.builderType, md);
370: 		}
371: 		
372: 		boolean isAbstract = (td.mods.flags & Flags.ABSTRACT) != 0;
373: 		if (!isAbstract) {
374: 			// Only non-abstract classes get the Builder implementation.
375: 			
376: 			// Create the builder implementation class.
377: 			job.builderImplType = findInnerClass(parent, job.builderImplClassName);
378: 			if (job.builderImplType == null) {
379: 				job.builderImplType = generateBuilderImplClass(job);
380: 				recursiveSetGeneratedBy(job.builderImplType.get(), annotationNode);
381: 			} else {
382: 				JCClassDecl builderImplTypeDeclaration = (JCClassDecl) job.builderImplType.get();
383: 				if (!builderImplTypeDeclaration.getModifiers().getFlags().contains(Modifier.STATIC)
384: 						|| builderImplTypeDeclaration.getModifiers().getFlags().contains(Modifier.ABSTRACT)) {
385: 					annotationNode.addError("Existing BuilderImpl must be a non-abstract static inner class.");
386: 					return;
387: 				}
388: 				sanityCheckForMethodGeneratingAnnotationsOnBuilderClass(job.builderImplType, annotationNode);
389: 			}
390: 
391: 			// Create a simple constructor for the BuilderImpl class.
392: 			JCMethodDecl cd = HandleConstructor.createConstructor(AccessLevel.PRIVATE, List.<JCAnnotation>nil(), job.builderImplType, List.<JavacNode>nil(), false, annotationNode);
393: 			if (cd != null) injectMethod(job.builderImplType, cd);
394: 			job.setBuilderToImpl();
395: 			
396: 			// Create the self() and build() methods in the BuilderImpl.
397: 			JCMethodDecl selfMethod = generateSelfMethod(job);
398: 			recursiveSetGeneratedBy(selfMethod, annotationNode);
399: 			injectMethod(job.builderType, selfMethod);
400: 			if (methodExists(job.buildMethodName, job.builderType, -1) == MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS) {
401: 				JCMethodDecl buildMethod = generateBuildMethod(job, buildMethodThrownExceptions);
402: 				recursiveSetGeneratedBy(buildMethod, annotationNode);
403: 				injectMethod(job.builderType, buildMethod);
404: 			}
405: 		}
406: 		
407: 		// Generate a constructor in the annotated class that takes a builder as argument.
408: 		if (!constructorExists(job.parentType, job.builderAbstractClassName)) {
409: 			job.setBuilderToAbstract();
410: 			generateBuilderBasedConstructor(job, superclassBuilderClass != null);
411: 		}
412: 		
413: 		if (!isAbstract) {
414: 			// Only non-abstract classes get the builder() and toBuilder() methods.
415: 			
416: 			// Add the builder() method to the annotated class.
417: 			// Allow users to specify their own builder() methods, e.g., to provide default values.
418: 			if (generateBuilderMethod && methodExists(job.builderMethodName, job.parentType, -1) != MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS) generateBuilderMethod = false;
419: 			if (generateBuilderMethod) {
420: 				JCMethodDecl builderMethod = generateBuilderMethod(job);
421: 				if (builderMethod != null) {
422: 					recursiveSetGeneratedBy(builderMethod, annotationNode);
423: 					injectMethod(job.parentType, builderMethod);
424: 				}
425: 			}

542: 			JCFieldAccess fieldInThis = maker.Select(maker.Ident(job.toName("this")), bfd.rawName);

544: 			JCStatement assign = maker.Exec(maker.Assign(fieldInThis, rhs));
545: 			
546: 			// In case of @Builder.Default, set the value to the default if it was not set in the builder.

557: 			if (hasNonNullAnnotations(bfd.originalFieldNode)) {

563: 		List<JCAnnotation> annsOnMethod = job.checkerFramework.generateSideEffectFree() ? List.of(maker.Annotation(genTypeRef(job.parentType, CheckerFrameworkVersion.NAME__SIDE_EFFECT_FREE), List.<JCExpression>nil())) : List.<JCAnnotation>nil();

569: 		// First add all generics that are present on the parent type.
570: 		ListBuffer<JCExpression> typeParamsForBuilderParameter = getTypeParamExpressions(job.typeParams, maker, job.sourceNode);
571: 		// Now add the <?, ?>.

573: 		typeParamsForBuilderParameter.append(wildcard);
574: 		wildcard = maker.Wildcard(maker.TypeBoundKind(BoundKind.UNBOUND), null);
575: 		typeParamsForBuilderParameter.append(wildcard);
576: 		JCTypeApply paramType = maker.TypeApply(namePlusTypeParamsToTypeReference(maker, job.parentType, job.getBuilderClassName(), false, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil()), typeParamsForBuilderParameter.toList());

589: 			null, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil(), params.toList(), List.<JCExpression>nil(),

753: 	private JCExpressionStatement createSetterCallWithInstanceValue(BuilderFieldData bfd, SuperBuilderJob job, String setterPrefix) {
754: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = job.getTreeMaker();
755: 		JCExpression[] tgt = new JCExpression[bfd.singularData == null ? 1 : 2];
756: 		if (bfd.obtainVia == null || !bfd.obtainVia.field().isEmpty()) {
757: 			for (int i = 0; i < tgt.length; i++) {
758: 				tgt[i] = maker.Select(maker.Ident(job.toName(INSTANCE_VARIABLE_NAME)), bfd.obtainVia == null ? bfd.rawName : job.toName(bfd.obtainVia.field()));
759: 			}
760: 		} else {
761: 			if (bfd.obtainVia.isStatic()) {
762: 				for (int i = 0; i < tgt.length; i++) {
763: 					JCExpression typeRef = namePlusTypeParamsToTypeReference(maker, job.parentType, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil());
764: 					JCExpression c = maker.Select(typeRef, job.toName(bfd.obtainVia.method()));
765: 					tgt[i] = maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(), c, List.<JCExpression>of(maker.Ident(job.toName(INSTANCE_VARIABLE_NAME))));
766: 				}
767: 			} else {
768: 				for (int i = 0; i < tgt.length; i++) {
769: 					JCExpression c = maker.Select(maker.Ident(job.toName(INSTANCE_VARIABLE_NAME)), job.toName(bfd.obtainVia.method()));
770: 					tgt[i] = maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(), c, List.<JCExpression>nil());
771: 				}
772: 			}
773: 		}
774: 		
775: 		JCExpression arg;
776: 		if (bfd.singularData == null) {
777: 			arg = tgt[0];
778: 		} else {
779: 			JCExpression eqNull = maker.Binary(CTC_EQUAL, tgt[0], maker.Literal(CTC_BOT, null));
780: 			JCExpression emptyCollection = bfd.singularData.getSingularizer().getEmptyExpression(bfd.singularData.getTargetFqn(), maker, bfd.singularData, job.parentType, job.sourceNode);

782: 		}

784: 		String setterName = HandlerUtil.buildAccessorName(job.sourceNode, setterPrefix, bfd.name.toString());
785: 		JCMethodInvocation apply = maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(), maker.Select(maker.Ident(job.toName(BUILDER_VARIABLE_NAME)), job.toName(setterName)), List.of(arg));
786: 		JCExpressionStatement exec = maker.Exec(apply);
787: 		return exec;
788: 	}
